follow-up time: 4.9 years (conservative treatment group), 5.6 years (operative treatment group)
outcome: Delivery complications (cesarean delivery rate, excessive bleeding)
cohort: 543 women with rectovaginal endometriosis treated either conservatively (n=183) or operatively (n=360)
finding: Women with rectovaginal endometriosis had comparable clinical pregnancy and live-birth rates regardless of initial treatment approach (conservative vs. operative).
mod_finding: The cesarean delivery rate was high in both groups (46% in the conservative group vs. 49% in the operative group).
